red_fitscube_close.pro


Routines

top source red_fitscube_close

SST pipeline

red_fitscube_close, fileassoc [, fitscube_info] [, newheader=strarr]

Close a fitscube file that was opened with red_fitscube_open and optionally write a modified header.

Parameters

fileassoc in type=assoc

The assoc variable of the opened file.

fitscube_info in out optional type=struct

Info about the opened fitscube file, including the header, the cube dimensions, and the logical unit. Undefined upon return.

Keywords

newheader in optional type=strarr

A (modified) header that should be written to the file.

Author information

Author:

Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics
